why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. Item 1: the brief has exactly two numbered checks, one for each expect line ("Check 1" for the --tsv JSON match, "Check 2" for the README grep). npm test and CSV-unchanged appear only under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)", so they are labelled as not gating and are not counted as a third check. This is a judgement call: a stricter reading could treat "Run `npm test`" as an extra check. Item 2: Check 1's PASS/FAIL conditions cover only the SAME/DIFFERENT comparison, the expected JSON array and command errors. Check 2's conditions cover only grep and README content. Neither requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief does say to run npm test, but the must_not items are about verifier checks and PASS/FAIL conditions, so that doesn't break them.
